description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs, with the x-axis representing the “Number of Samples Generated” on a linear scale ranging from K=8 to K=64, and the y-axis representing “Micro F1 (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 25% to 50%. Four distinct lines are plotted: the blue line with circle markers represents TACRED, starting at approximately 23% at K=8 and rising to about 29.5% at K=64; the orange line with triangle markers represents TACRED-Revisit, beginning at roughly 23% at K=8 and peaking at about 31% at K=32 before declining to approximately 30% at K=64; the green line with diamond markers represents Re-TACRED, starting at around 35% at K=8, increasing to a peak of 51% at K=32, and then decreasing to about 48% at K=64; and the red line with star markers represents SemEval, beginning at approximately 42% at K=8 and steadily increasing to about 52% at K=64.
